# Installing ledger-memory on Kimi Code

## What gets emitted

- `.kimi-plugin/plugin.json`
- the manifest's `sessionStart.skill` field, naming the configured bootstrap skill

## Installing

```
/plugins install https://github.com/prime-radiant-inc/ledger-memory
```

Or find it through the Kimi marketplace. Consult Kimi Code's plugin docs if this command doesn't match your installed version.
